title: Slave Timeout Register Not Accessible via Crossbar
description: A configuration register at 0x0FF0 (slave timeout control) is never accessible because the crossbar's upper address bound check uses a strict less-than instead of less-than-or-equal.
bug_signature: UVM_ERROR: [DECERR] Address 0x0FF0 generated DECERR but is in the valid S0 range
expected_root_cause: The boundary check `addr < 16'h1000` excludes address 0x0FF0 from the valid S0 range when it should be included [5, 26].
failure_log:
ADDR=0x0FF0. Crossbar check: 0x0FF0 < 0x1000 = True (should be selected). ERROR: Route sent to DECERR.
UVM_ERROR: Off-by-one in boundary check.
success_log: 0x0FF0 routes to S0; register accessible and returns correct value.
